title: Power Liftgate Circuit (B1700-v3)
shortDescription: A power liftgate / tailgate motor or control circuit fault stored as B1700-v3.
fullDescription: The body controller logs B1700-v3 when a power liftgate / tailgate motor or control circuit fault is detected. The fault often disables the affected convenience or safety function until repaired and may persist after a battery reset.
safetyImpact: The liftgate may close on a person or fail to latch; manual override is required.

causes.cause: Wiring chafe in liftgate hinge area

symptoms: Liftgate refuses to open or close from button
Liftgate reverses direction on its own
Beep sounds and gate stops mid-travel
One strut moves while the other does not

fixSteps.title: Reset Liftgate Position
fixSteps.instruction: Manually close fully, then perform OEM relearn (often holds the close button 5 seconds).

fixSteps.title: Inspect Hinges & Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the headliner trim and inspect the harness for chafing at the hinge.

fixSteps.title: Test Strut Motors
fixSteps.instruction: Bidirectional command each strut; replace any that fail to actuate.

fixSteps.title: Replace Liftgate Module
fixSteps.instruction: Fit OEM module and program with VIN; recalibrate end stops.

faq.q: Why does it reverse on close?
faq.a: A pinch sensor or strut detects abnormal resistance and reverses for safety.

faq.q: Can I close it manually?
faq.a: Yes; most systems allow manual close, then relearn fully open / fully closed positions.

title: Sliding Door Power Circuit (B1850-v2)
shortDescription: A power sliding door motor or control circuit fault stored as B1850-v2.
fullDescription: The body controller logs B1850-v2 when a power sliding door motor or control circuit fault is detected. The fault often disables the affected convenience or safety function until repaired and may persist after a battery reset.
safetyImpact: The door may close on an occupant or open in motion; manual mode is the safe fallback.

causes.cause: Pinch sensor or door track obstructed

symptoms: Sliding door inoperative from any switch
Door creeps open while parked on a slope

fixSteps.title: Clean and Lubricate Tracks
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum debris and apply a dry-film lubricant to the rollers and tracks.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Drive Cable
fixSteps.instruction: Check the cable spool for fraying or jumped strands; replace if worn.

fixSteps.title: Test Motor & Cinch
fixSteps.instruction: Use scan tool to bidirectionally command motor and cinch; isolate the failed unit.

fixSteps.title: Replace Motor Assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Fit OEM drive unit, then perform open/close relearn.

faq.q: Can I disable power mode?
faq.a: Yes; most vans allow a manual-only mode through the overhead console.

faq.q: Why does it work cold but not warm?
faq.a: Heat-soaked motor windings open as resistance climbs; classic motor failure pattern.

title: Power Window Switch / Motor Circuit (B2200-v2)
shortDescription: A power window switch or motor circuit fault stored as B2200-v2.
fullDescription: The body controller logs B2200-v2 when a power window switch or motor circuit fault is detected. The fault often disables the affected convenience or safety function until repaired and may persist after a battery reset.
safetyImpact: Window may not seal, allowing weather intrusion; pinch protection may be disabled.

causes.cause: BCM logic fault for express up/down

symptoms: Window fails to express up or down
Window goes down but not up (or vice versa)

fixSteps.title: Reinitialize Window
fixSteps.instruction: Hold switch in full up for 3 seconds then full down for 3 seconds to relearn end stops.

fixSteps.title: Swap Switches
fixSteps.instruction: Move a known-good switch to the failing position to isolate switch vs wiring.

fixSteps.title: Test Motor Voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm both polarities reach the motor; replace motor if voltage is good.

fixSteps.title: Replace Regulator
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM regulator + motor assembly; reinitialize after install.

faq.q: Why express-up only?
faq.a: Pinch protection requires a known reference; relearn restores express-up.

faq.q: Are aftermarket regulators ok?
faq.a: Mid-tier brands are fine; cheap units often fail again within a year.

title: Trunk Lid / Decklid Circuit (B2300-v2)
shortDescription: A trunk lid release, latch, or cinch circuit fault stored as B2300-v2.
fullDescription: The body controller logs B2300-v2 when a trunk lid release, latch, or cinch circuit fault is detected. The fault often disables the affected convenience or safety function until repaired and may persist after a battery reset.
safetyImpact: Trunk may not latch securely or release on demand; valet mode may be disabled.

causes.cause: Wiring break in trunk hinge boot

symptoms: Trunk will not release from key fob or button
Cinch motor cycles but trunk does not pull down

fixSteps.title: Test Release Methods
fixSteps.instruction: Try fob, dash button, kick sensor, and emergency release; pattern reveals the failed input.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Hinge Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the trunk and flex the hinge boot while watching live data for dropouts.

fixSteps.title: Test Latch Actuator
fixSteps.instruction: Bidirectional-command the latch; replace if it fails to cycle.

fixSteps.title: Replace Latch Assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM latch and verify cinch and ajar switch operation.

faq.q: Why ajar light with trunk closed?
faq.a: The microswitch in the latch is sticking; cleaning rarely lasts; replace the latch.

faq.q: Is the emergency pull tab safe?
faq.a: Yes; pulling the glow-in-the-dark tab inside the trunk releases the latch mechanically.

symptoms: Trunk will not release from key fob or button
Cinch motor cycles but trunk does not pull down

fixSteps.title: Test Release Methods
fixSteps.instruction: Try fob, dash button, kick sensor, and emergency release; pattern reveals the failed input.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Hinge Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the trunk and flex the hinge boot while watching live data for dropouts.

fixSteps.title: Test Latch Actuator
fixSteps.instruction: Bidirectional-command the latch; replace if it fails to cycle.

fixSteps.title: Replace Latch Assembly
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM latch and verify cinch and ajar switch operation.

faq.q: Why ajar light with trunk closed?
faq.a: The microswitch in the latch is sticking; cleaning rarely lasts; replace the latch.

faq.q: Is the emergency pull tab safe?
faq.a: Yes; pulling the glow-in-the-dark tab inside the trunk releases the latch mechanically.

title: Brake Force Monitor Circuit (C1300-v2)
shortDescription: A brake force / pedal force sensor monitor fault stored as C1300-v2.
fullDescription: The chassis controller logs C1300-v2 when a brake force / pedal force sensor monitor fault is detected. The fault often disables the affected convenience or safety function until repaired and may persist after a battery reset.
safetyImpact: ESP, ABS assist, and brake-by-wire functions may degrade; longer stopping distances possible.

causes.cause: Failed brake pedal force / pressure sensor
Sensor wiring chafe near master cylinder

symptoms: Hard or soft brake pedal feel

fixSteps.title: Scan Brake System
fixSteps.instruction: Read codes from ABS, ESP, and brake booster modules; correlate freeze frame data.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Visually inspect pedal force and master cylinder pressure sensors for damage or fluid wetness.

fixSteps.title: Bleed ABS Module
fixSteps.instruction: Use scan tool to perform automated ABS bleed if pedal feel is spongy.

fixSteps.title: Replace Sensor / Module
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM sensor or ABS module and code it; perform calibration.

faq.q: Is the car safe to drive?
faq.a: Limit driving to reaching service; baseline hydraulic braking still works but assist is limited.

faq.q: Why after fluid change?
faq.a: Air introduced during bleeding will trigger pressure-monitor codes until purged.
